description: LastLogin stores the timestamp of the user's most recent login. It is currently a string of fixed length 19 characters representing a datetime in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (e.g., '2023-03-30 00:00:00'). All 30 records are non‑null; 28 distinct values with two dates appearing twice. The intended data type is datetime64[ns].
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert string timestamps to native datetime type, e.g., '2023-03-30 00:00:00' → 2023-03-30 00:00:00 (datetime).
[VALIDATE] Verify all values conform to the 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format after conversion.
